functions.name: roguejoin
functions.sourceReview: Read the complete extralev.c roguejoin() body. Both horizontal and vertical L-shaped corridor branches preserve middle-point rn2 order, min/max loop bounds, and corr calls; no unported callee result is discarded.

callers.source: extralev.c roguecorr() calls roguejoin() after placing both connecting doors

functions.name: roguecorr
functions.sourceReview: Read the complete extralev.c roguecorr() body. XL_DOWN and XL_RIGHT branches preserve dummy versus real room coordinates, wall checks, door creation, D_NODOOR writes, endpoint mutation, and roguejoin ordering; impossible branches have no valid production reachability and no result-valued unported callee.

callers.source: extralev.c makeroguerooms() walks each selected XL_DOWN and XL_RIGHT edge through roguecorr()

functions.name: miniwalk
functions.sourceReview: Read the complete extralev.c miniwalk() body. Candidate directions retain C short-circuit order and one-in-ten reconnect draws, selected-direction rn2 order, bidirectional door bits, recursion, and terminal return; no unported callee is used.

callers.source: extralev.c makeroguerooms() starts miniwalk() at two rn2(3) coordinates

functions.name: makeroguerooms
functions.sourceReview: Read the complete extralev.c makeroguerooms() body. The nine-cell real/dummy decision and dimensions preserve C RNG and evaluation order, miniwalk starts before nroom reset, add_room receives source coordinates and lighting draw, and all selected edges dispatch roguecorr(); no result-valued unported callee remains.

callers.source: mklev.c makelevel() selects makeroguerooms() for procedural Rogue levels before stair and fill work
sp_lev.c splev_initlev() dispatches LVLINIT_ROGUE to makeroguerooms()
mklev.c mklev() calls makelevel(), which reaches the Rogue generator on a new level
do.c goto_level() invokes mklev() when the destination has no saved level
teleport.c level_tele() accepts the numeric procedural Rogue destination and calls schedule_goto()

functions.name: corr
functions.sourceReview: Read the complete extralev.c corr() body. The rn2(50) choice preserves CORR versus SCORR terrain assignment and no other state or output branch is omitted.

callers.source: extralev.c roguejoin() writes every L-shaped corridor square with corr()

functions.name: makerogueghost
functions.sourceReview: Read the complete extralev.c makerogueghost() body. Room selection, ghost creation and sleep/name steps, optional food, weapon, bow, arrows, armor, curses, erosionproof flags, quantities, weights, and fake amulet branches preserve source order and RNG calls. Supporting result-valued callees were wired through existing makemon, christen_monst, roguename, mksobj_at, weight, and curse ports.

callers.source: mklev.c makelevel() calls makerogueghost() immediately after makeroguerooms() on Rogue levels
mklev.c mklev() calls makelevel(), which reaches makerogueghost() on a new Rogue level
do.c goto_level() invokes mklev() when the destination has no saved level
teleport.c level_tele() accepts the numeric procedural Rogue destination and calls schedule_goto()

entryPointReview: The selected source range has one production entry point: debug level teleport (Ctrl-V) enters level_tele(), schedules the numeric Rogue destination, goto_level() invokes mklev makelevel(), and its Is_rogue_level branch runs makeroguerooms() followed by makerogueghost(); the LVLINIT_ROGUE dispatcher is also wired for special-level initialization.
